title: REQ · A second NPC is spawned and resolves its idle animation from the manifest
summary: BootScene spawns the NPC and its idle animation key comes from the manifest
description: Context: BootScene.createCharacter uses resolveCharacterAnimation and ensureAnim. Desired behavior: with a mocked Phaser and a content mock holding boy and npc, create() adds two sprites and plays character:npc:idle. Expected result: a pure key helper and BootScene agree. Why: proves manifest-driven animation for NPCs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manifest with asset character:npc defining idle, when resolveCharacterAnimation runs for the NPC idle, then it returns character:npc and idle
Given a mocked scene with boy and npc, when BootScene.create runs, then add.sprite is called twice and the NPC sprite plays character:npc:idle
technical_constraints: Phaser mocked with vi.mock as in bootSceneCharacters.test.ts
